steps.en: Court processing reports have been generated
steps.why_en: The reports are only named stubs.

steps.en: Processing errors are detected and recorded
steps.why_en: Only a field name exists; nothing records court errors.
steps.why_id: Hanya nama field; tidak ada yang mencatat error court.

steps.en: A work item is created for the errors
steps.id: Work item dibuat untuk error tersebut
steps.why_en: Work item creation is only a placeholder that logs and does nothing.
steps.why_id: Pembuatan work item hanya placeholder yang mencatat log.

steps.en: The OIC sees the error work item on the dashboard
steps.id: OIC melihat work item error di dashboard
steps.why_en: The dashboard is empty and the work item menu is switched off.
steps.why_id: Dashboard masih kosong dan menu work item dimatikan.
